{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for duplicates in order_id
duplicates = df['order_id'].duplicated().sum()

# Check for invalid age values (e.g., negative or extremely high)
invalid_ages = df[(df['customer_age'] < 0) | (df['customer_age'] > 120)].shape[0]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = df['customer_age'].mean()

# Report findings
duplicates, invalid_ages, mean_age"}
